title: bouba_sens: A Pre-Registered Cross-Modal Plasticity Benchmark
description:
A pre-registered benchmark measuring three invariants of cross-modal plasticity (B-1 congenital-blindness T1/T2 gap, B-2 informational migration, B-3 perceptive/proprioceptive structural asymmetry) across five synthetic worlds and a 4.5-modal real Studyforrest Phase-2 bridge. Thresholds (0.05 / 0.10 / 0.02) were locked locally in git (dated design specification, 2026-04-20) before the evaluation campaign; they are not registered on OSF (registration 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q6JYN covers dream-of-kiki H1-H4 only). Companion to the TMLR submission v0.1.

Status of the invariants (2026-10-25): B-1 is retracted after multi-seed validation (ADR-0019); B-2 is null under every estimator (ADR-0019); B-3 is reported as an uncalibrated magnitude: the 0.02 threshold was never compared with a null; an independent binomial null invalidates the reading of the bare exceedance of 0.02; no compatibility or rejection verdict is established before a paired calibration of the median (same probe for the five queries, shared seeds and worlds; ADR-0021). The earlier claim that a frozen PSK mux with hard-binary transducer gating minimally reproduces the Amedi 2007 T1/T2 asymmetry rested on the single-seed B-1 pattern and is withdrawn with it.
notes: Built on nerve-wml v1.5.3+ (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19656342). Reproducible via `bash scripts/reproduce_paper_v01.sh`; byte-identity verification via `scripts/sha256_manifest.py` against `reports/MANIFEST.json`.
